attchmntText: Rubfila International Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Rubfila International Limited has placed the re-appointment of Mr. G. Krishna Kumar, DIN 01450683, as Managing Director before shareholders for approval. The Board of Directors approved this re-appointment at its meeting held on 12 November 2026. The new term is for three years, effective from 1 November 2026. This follows the expiration of his existing term on 31 October 2026. Mr. Kumar is not related to any other director of the company. He is not debarred from holding the office of director by any SEBI order or other authority. The announcement is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Shareholder approval is pending.

attchmntText: Rubfila International Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: RUBFILA INTERNATIONAL Limited filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 with the Stock Exchange Mumbai and National Stock Exchange of India. The Board of Directors approved the standalone and consolidated financial statements during a meeting held on 12th November 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was 17,008.39 lakhs, with a profit after tax of 755.17 lakhs. Consolidated revenue from operations stood at 17,167.75 lakhs, with a consolidated profit after tax of 755.17 lakhs. The company also submitted the limited review report by its statutory auditors. These filings comply with Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
